row.name: junior_inbox_items_kind_check
row.value: ("junior_inbox_items"."kind" = 'notice' and "junior_inbox_items"."request" is null and "junior_inbox_items"."answer" is null) or ("junior_inbox_items"."kind" = 'action' and ("junior_inbox_items"."request" is not null or (("junior_inbox_items"."dedupe_key" like 'plugin:%' or "junior_inbox_items"."dedupe_key" like 'automation:%') and "junior_inbox_items"."answer" is null)))

row.name: junior_inbox_items_owner_check
row.value: ("junior_inbox_items"."owner_kind" = 'conversation' and "junior_inbox_items"."dedupe_key" not like 'automation:%') or ("junior_inbox_items"."owner_kind" = 'automation' and "junior_inbox_items"."dedupe_key" like 'automation:%')

row.name: junior_inbox_items_status_check
row.value: ("junior_inbox_items"."status" = 'open' and "junior_inbox_items"."closed_at" is null) or ("junior_inbox_items"."status" in ('done', 'dismissed') and "junior_inbox_items"."closed_at" is not null)
